title: This platform's own stack: run the site's latest template
why: Template v2 (23 Nov 2026) adds the S3 browser (read role: list and open files; change role: add a bucket's CORS rule through Cloud Control) and lets the change role update this stack, so later changes need no console visit (Dinis: "for now [allow] a lot of updates on [the] CloudFormation stack. We'll tighten that a bit later"). The first move to v2 is made in the console, because v1 cannot update itself; every later version is applied here.
summary: Shows the template AWS holds beside the site's; then AWS's own change set; then executes it. Parameters keep their values.
